title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Earnestly Studying and Implementing the Spirit of the Third Session of the Eleventh National People's Congress
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Earnestly Studying and Implementing the Spirit of the Third Session of the Eleventh National People's Congress

Fa Fa [2010] No. 11

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The recently concluded Third Session of the Eleventh National People's Congress was an extremely important conference convened under the strong leadership of the Communist Party of China, while the people of all ethnic groups across the country calmly responded to the impact of the international financial crisis, took the lead in achieving economic recovery and improvement in the world, and made new major achievements in reform, opening up, and socialist modernization. To better study, implement, and carry forward the spirit of the conference, continuously strengthen and improve the work of the people's courts, we hereby notify you on the relevant issues as follows:

I. Earnestly Study and Implement the Spirit of the Conference, Further Enhance the Consciousness and Initiative in Doing a Good Job in the Work of the People's Courts

This session carefully deliberated and approved the work report of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress delivered by Chairman Wu Bangguo, the government work report delivered by Premier Wen Jiabao, the work report of the Supreme People's Court delivered by President Wang Shengjun, and other important reports; passed the amendment to the Electoral Law; and successfully completed all tasks. The resolutions adopted by the session and the approved work report of the Supreme People's Court summarized the work of the past year and put forward the main tasks for 2010. During the "Two Sessions" (NPC and CPPCC), deputies and members fully affirmed the achievements of the people's courts in their work, paid great attention to the difficulties and problems faced, and put forward many good opinions and suggestions. This year is a critical year for continuing to respond to the international financial crisis, maintaining steady and relatively fast economic growth, and accelerating the transformation of the economic development model; it is also an important year for comprehensively achieving the goals of the "Eleventh Five-Year Plan" and laying a solid foundation for the "Twelfth Five-Year Plan" development. The tasks of the people's courts are heavy and the responsibilities are significant. Courts across the country must earnestly study the various important reports approved by this session, especially the work report of the Supreme People's Court delivered by President Wang Shengjun, effectively implement the spirit of the conference, correctly understand the situation faced by the people's courts, face up to the challenges and tests encountered in the work of the people's courts, further enhance the enthusiasm and initiative in doing a good job, transform the spirit of the conference into positive and effective work measures, and into the conscious actions of the vast number of police officers, so as to promote new development in the work of the people's courts.

II. Seriously Implement the Resolutions of the Conference and Promote All Work of the People's Courts to a New Level

Courts at all levels must, in accordance with the requirements of the resolutions of the Third Session of the Eleventh National People's Congress, hold high the great banner of socialism with Chinese characteristics, take Deng Xiaoping Theory and the important thought of "Three Represents" as guidance, thoroughly implement the Scientific Outlook on Development, adhere to the work guiding ideology of "the Party's cause above all else, the people's interests above all else, and the Constitution and laws above all else," adhere to the work theme of "serving the overall situation and administering justice for the people," deeply advance the three key tasks of resolving social conflicts, innovating social management, and ensuring fair and incorruptible law enforcement, and strive to create a new situation in the work of the people's courts. In accordance with the requirements of the Central Economic Work Conference of "five more focuses" and the "four focuses" in the Government Work Report, we must adhere to active justice, highlight the focus of judicial services, further adhere to, improve, and develop the work principle of "mediation first, combining mediation and adjudication," promote the resolution of social conflicts, actively participate in and promote innovation in social management, and continuously improve the level of serving the overall situation with more solid and effective work. We must closely focus on promoting judicial fairness and efficiency, and continue to deepen the reform of the judicial system. We must earnestly implement the Party Central Committee's opinions on deepening judicial system reform, thoroughly implement the "Third Five-Year Reform Outline for the People's Courts (2009-2013)," start from improving trial management, and achieve new progress in promoting judicial fairness and efficiency. We must strengthen the quality of cases and trial process management, improve the mechanism for the separation of powers and checks and balances, and accelerate the institutional construction of judicial democracy and judicial openness. We must closely focus on ensuring fair and incorruptible justice, and comprehensively improve the quality of the team. We must continue to deepen education on the socialist concept of rule of law, deepen the theme practice activity of "people's judges for the people," establish the core values of justice, integrity, and serving the people for judges, focus on improving the professional ethics of judges, accelerate the construction of a system for preventing and punishing corruption, and strive to cultivate a good style of being close to the people and serving the people. We must closely focus on improving the judicial capacity at the grassroots level, and vigorously strengthen grassroots construction. We must fully recognize the important role of grassroots courts in resolving social conflicts, devote more energy to strengthening grassroots construction, continuously improve the capacity and quality of grassroots judges, focus on solving the practical difficulties of grassroots courts, strengthen supervision and guidance over grassroots work, pay attention to summarizing and drawing on the work experience of grassroots courts, and promote the overall development of the work of the people's courts. Focusing on improving judicial credibility, we must improve the system for accepting supervision by the People's Congress, earnestly accept democratic supervision by the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, support and cooperate with procuratorial organs in legally performing their legal supervision duties, broaden channels for accepting social supervision, and further improve the work of the people's courts.

III. Earnestly Handle the Work of Handling Opinions and Suggestions of Deputies to the People's Congress and Members of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, and Further Strengthen Communication and Contact with All Parties

During the "Two Sessions," deputies and members put forward many opinions and suggestions in areas such as performing trial functions, deepening judicial system reform, improving team quality, and strengthening grassroots infrastructure construction. This reflects the care and support of deputies and members for the work of the people's courts and is also the direction for our efforts to improve work. All courts across the country must attach great importance to the work of handling opinions and suggestions of deputies and members, improve work systems, perfect work procedures, carefully sort out and break down the opinions and suggestions of deputies and members, incorporate them into supervision, clarify responsible persons, clarify quality requirements, clarify processing deadlines, and make them an important part of the annual performance assessment. We must earnestly do a good job in communicating with deputies and members, adopt various methods such as inviting discussions, home visits, and telephone communication to listen to opinions, promptly feedback the handling situation, and improve the satisfaction rate of handling work. We must strengthen contacts with deputies to the People's Congress and members of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, various democratic parties, the Federation of Industry and Commerce, and non-party personages, experts and scholars, lawyers, and grassroots people, and sincerely listen to their opinions and suggestions on the work of the people's courts. We must give play to the role of specially invited advisors and specially invited supervisors to provide decision-making consultation and supervision opinions for the work of the people's courts, and improve the level of scientific and democratic decision-making. We must earnestly implement the provisions on accepting supervision by news media and public opinion, humbly listen to the opinions of the media and netizens, and continuously improve work.

IV. Strengthen Organizational Leadership to Ensure the Effective Implementation of the Spirit of the Conference

The Party groups of courts at all levels should carefully study, incorporate the implementation of the spirit of the Third Session of the Eleventh National People's Congress into the overall work deployment, and strengthen organizational leadership. In light of local actual conditions, specific divisions of labor should be made for various related tasks, responsible leaders and responsible departments should be clarified, specific measures should be formulated, and earnest supervision and inspection should be carried out, with a firm grasp on implementation, to effectively solve the source, fundamental, and basic issues that restrict the work of the people's courts. Higher-level courts should urge lower-level courts to implement the spirit of the conference, and lower-level courts should promptly report issues and suggestions related to the implementation of the conference spirit. Through the joint efforts of people's courts at all levels, better serve the overall situation and administer justice for the people, promote the work of the people's courts to a new level, and make new and greater contributions to promoting sound and rapid economic and social development.

March 20, 2010
